headline: Conservation closure at Little River and a merger of the Harbor Commission and Shellfish Commission.
summary: Several draft plans are on the agenda, including the annual report and the 2026-2027 strategic plan. Updates on the UNE water discharge permit and emergency locator signs are also listed.
